This Egyptian cross-sectional study examined 111 multidrug-resistant and carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from 2020-2021. Carbapenem resistance was extremely high at 98.2%. Colistin resistance was notable in 23.9% of K. pneumoniae, although mcr genes were absent. blaNDM and blaOXA-48-like predominated, especially in K. pneum
